title: Living Alone Vlog 🌿🧸Cozy Home Cooking, Cute Kitchen Haul🍒 & Healing Days After Moving
description:
Hello friends 🌷
I recently moved back to a familiar city and slowly started rebuilding my little home again.

In this vlog, I spent my days cooking cozy meals, organizing my kitchen, trying cute drinks and snacks, unboxing adorable kitchenware, and enjoying quiet moments alone ☁️

Lately I’ve been learning that even small things — making breakfast, cleaning, grocery shopping, or sitting down for a peaceful meal — can slowly heal a tired mind 🤍

I hope this video can be a comforting little break in your day too.
Thank you so much for being here with me 🌸

☕ Cozy coffee moments
🏠 Living alone diaries
📦 Unboxing & organizing
🍉 Summer food & healing days

Don’t forget to eat well today 💕
